comment: Pinned upstream binaries for LiteSVM and the local validator. Fetched read-only from devnet by scripts/fetch-runtime-programs.mjs and verified by SHA-256 of the ProgramData ELF. If upstream redeploys, the fetch fails until the new binary is reviewed and re-pinned.

subscriptions.upstream: solana-foundation/subscriptions program-v0.5.0 era (devnet redeploy after the 2026-08-10 release; account layouts asserted equal to the tag in integrations/subscriptions.rs)

pyth_receiver.upstream: pyth-network/pyth-crosschain solana receiver; identical binary on devnet and mainnet
